sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s is an appropriate U.S. degree basis; department admits to PhD. Admission remains
dependent on mathematics preparation and central academic review. F-1 status is not a domestic citizenship
classification. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Arrange transcripts and three referees; prepare CV and statement; pay fee before submission. For late or
independently funded applications, contact the Director of Graduate Studies. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Upload documents online; all required recommendations/documents needed for review; status visible in
account. [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Current portal confirms 2027 deadline; most rules are standing. [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027 is listed for mathematics in the current portal; department sets January 15 for international
admission/support and TA priority. Do not substitute later university-wide international April 15 or domestic
May/July dates. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Aim to complete the file by January 15. Central office routes it only after required documents and
recommendations arrive; no separate grace period established. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Official TOEFL: 79 before January 21, 2026 or 4.0 after; IELTS 6.5 or DET 115. Self-report plus agency
transmission when testing is required. ETS 1837. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Awarded accredited U.S. bachelor’s satisfies English proficiency. Alternatively, official transcript or registrar
attestation sent directly to gradtranscripts@uky.edu may establish English as sole teaching language. An
in-progress degree alone is not expressly listed: resolve before applying. [s2]

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required for admission or TA; self-reporting permitted, official ETS 1837 if reporting officially. A few
university supplemental fellowships may require GRE. [s1]

Three; at least two from upper-level mathematics instructors or others familiar with your mathematical work.
Directory also asks recommenders about teaching/tutoring/computing and comparative mathematics ability.

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
FY 2027 university baseline announcement: minimum $22,000; department may pay more. This is not a
confirmed 2027-28 mathematics offer, nor a verified 12-month award. Assistantships include standard tuition
and mandatory fees, excluding program/student-specific fees. [s5] [s6]
Years of support; Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Standing rule]
International applicants are considered for TA automatically with mathematics application; doctoral applicants
have priority. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time graduate enrollment and progress; full assistantship normally 20 hours/week. International TA
orientation applies. Renewal terms must accompany offer. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International application $75, nonrefundable, due before submission; separate application/fee for each
program. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published central waiver covers U.S. military veterans and qualifying military dependents with documentation;
no general international hardship waiver verified. [s2]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Department January 15 and optional 1-2 page statement conflict with undated program directory February 1
and required 2 page statement. Use current portal January 15; prepare 2 pages pending confirmation. [s1] [s3]
[s4]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm statement requiredness, referee invitation timing/update/reuse, separate scholarship references,
exact math stipend/support duration and 2027 commitment date. The expanded shortlist covers direct and
adjacent matches with primary paper evidence; Corso has older evidence only. Confirm individual supervision
capacity. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic geometry
David Jensen
Curves, moduli, tropical and nonarchimedean geometry. [s8] [s9]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · The Embedding Theorem in Hurwitz-Brill-Noether Theory
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Algebraic geometry and representation theory
Christopher Manon
Toric vector bundles, valuations, tropical geometry; equivariant structures. [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2025 · Toric Vector Bundles, Valuations and Tropical Geometry
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Commutative algebra and algebraic geometry
Uwe Nagel
Graded rings, Stanley-Reisner ideals and combinatorial algebra. [s8] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Alexander duals of symmetric simplicial complexes and Stanley-Reisner ideals
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry / commutative algebra
Alberto Corso
Commutative and computational algebra, integral dependence, blow-up algebras and homological methods.
[a12] [a12p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2018; latest dated item verified in the institutional profile · Iterated socles and integral dependence in
regular rings
Historical publication evidence. A newer paper was not established in the official sources checked; confirm current projects
before contacting.
Algebraic geometry / algebraic combinatorics
Richard Ehrenborg
Algebraic and geometric combinatorics, Coxeter arrangements, posets and toric g-vectors; adjacent to the
geometry interests. [b14] [b14p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint, revised August 2026 · The toric g-vector of nestohedra
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Benjamin Braun
Lattice polytopes, Ehrhart theory, graded algebras, resolutions and triangulations; connections to Gorenstein
algebras. [b18] [b18p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Equatorial Flow Triangulations of Gorenstein Flow Polytopes
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry / representation theory (combinatorial)
Margaret Readdy
Geometric and algebraic combinatorics, Bruhat theory, stratifications, toric invariants and connections to
Shimura varieties. [b16] [b16p]

Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint, revised August 2026 · The toric g-vector of nestohedra
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory / algebraic geometry
Martha Yip
Combinatorial representation theory, symmetric functions, flag positroids and lattice polytopes. [b20] [b20p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Flag positroid pipe dreams
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Representation theory
Khrystyna Serhiyenko
Quiver representations, associative and cluster algebras, categorification, friezes, syzygies and dimer models.
[b22] [b22p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Consistent dimer models on surfaces with boundary
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory
Xuancheng Shao
Analytic number theory and additive combinatorics, multiplicative functions, character sums and uniformity
estimates. [b24] [b24p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Higher uniformity of arithmetic functions in short intervals II. Almost all intervals
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Arithmetic geometry / algebraic topology (adjacent)
Nathaniel Stapleton
Chromatic and equivariant homotopy theory with links to formal and p-divisible groups; an adjacent
arithmetic-geometric rather than conventional arithmetic-geometry option. [b26] [b26p]
Current faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not publicly confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Additive power operations in equivariant cohomology
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s is an appropriate U.S. degree basis; department admits to PhD. Admission remains
dependent on mathematics preparation and central academic review. F-1 status is not a domestic citizenship
classification. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Arrange transcripts and three referees; prepare CV and statement; pay fee before submission. For late or
independently funded applications, contact the Director of Graduate Studies. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Upload documents online; all required recommendations/documents needed for review; status visible in
account. [s2]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Current portal confirms 2027 deadline; most rules are standing. [s3]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027 is listed for mathematics in the current portal; department sets January 15 for international
admission/support and TA priority. Do not substitute later university-wide international April 15 or domestic
May/July dates. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Aim to complete the file by January 15. Central office routes it only after required documents and
recommendations arrive; no separate grace period established. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Official TOEFL: 79 before January 21, 2026 or 4.0 after; IELTS 6.5 or DET 115. Self-report plus agency
transmission when testing is required. ETS 1837. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Awarded accredited U.S. bachelor’s satisfies English proficiency. Alternatively, official transcript or registrar
attestation sent directly to gradtranscripts@uky.edu may establish English as sole teaching language. An
in-progress degree alone is not expressly listed: resolve before applying. [s2]

GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required for admission or TA; self-reporting permitted, official ETS 1837 if reporting officially. A few
university supplemental fellowships may require GRE. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload transcripts from all higher-education institutions attended. Official copies required after accepting
admission. [s1]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; at least two from upper-level mathematics instructors or others familiar with your mathematical work.
Directory also asks recommenders about teaching/tutoring/computing and comparative mathematics ability.
[s1] [s4]
Scholarship references; What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Updating and
reusing letters [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Receipt confirmation [Prior cycle]
2023 central DGS manual says applicants can return to the application to see who submitted; reconfirm
current interface. [s7]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Upload CV/resume; no published page limit or formatting rule. [s1]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement [Conflict]
Department: optional but strongly recommended,1-2 pages; cover motivation/career fit, preparation and
development goals, research interests, and experiences affecting responses to challenges (paraphrased).
Central directory says required 2 pages: prepare 2 pages and confirm portal. [s1] [s4]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included within the 1-2 page statement; no separately prescribed research-interest essay found. [s1]
Research proposal; Publications list; Course-list document; Other short answers / materials
[Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Optional mathematical writing: course report, honors thesis, REU paper or poster. No published
length/format/upload-versus-link specification. [s1]

Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
FY 2027 university baseline announcement: minimum $22,000; department may pay more. This is not a
confirmed 2027-28 mathematics offer, nor a verified 12-month award. Assistantships include standard tuition
and mandatory fees, excluding program/student-specific fees. [s5] [s6]
Years of support; Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Standing rule]
International applicants are considered for TA automatically with mathematics application; doctoral applicants
have priority. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time graduate enrollment and progress; full assistantship normally 20 hours/week. International TA
orientation applies. Renewal terms must accompany offer. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International application $75, nonrefundable, due before submission; separate application/fee for each
program. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published central waiver covers U.S. military veterans and qualifying military dependents with documentation;
no general international hardship waiver verified. [s2]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Department January 15 and optional 1-2 page statement conflict with undated program directory February 1
and required 2 page statement. Use current portal January 15; prepare 2 pages pending confirmation. [s1] [s3]
[s4]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm statement requiredness, referee invitation timing/update/reuse, separate scholarship references,
exact math stipend/support duration and 2027 commitment date. The expanded shortlist covers direct and
adjacent matches with primary paper evidence; Corso has older evidence only. Confirm individual supervision
capacity. [s1] [s2]
